Index: qml/RecordList.qml
===================================================================
--- qml/RecordList.qml	
+++ qml/RecordList.qml	
@@ -1,123 +1,129 @@
+// Copyright (c) 2026-present, Dwyco, Inc.
+//
+// This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+// License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this file,
+// You can obtain one at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Controls
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 import PoisonLog 1.0
 
 Frame {
     id: root
     padding: 0
 
     background: Rectangle {
         color: "#ffffff"
         radius: 8
         border.color: "#dfe6e1"
     }
 
     ColumnLayout {
         anchors.fill: parent
         anchors.margins: 12
         spacing: 8
 
         RowLayout {
             Layout.fillWidth: true
             Label {
                 text: "Records"
                 font.pixelSize: 18
                 font.bold: true
                 color: "#24382a"
             }
             Item {
                 Layout.fillWidth: true
             }
             Label {
                 text: App.recordCount
                 color: "#6a7b6e"
             }
         }
 
         Label {
             Layout.fillWidth: true
             text: "Newest first"
             font.pixelSize: 11
             color: "#87968b"
         }
 
         ListView {
             id: list
             Layout.fillWidth: true
             Layout.fillHeight: true
             clip: true
             spacing: 2
             model: App.recordsModel
 
             delegate: ItemDelegate {
                 id: delegate
                 width: list.width
                 height: 78
                 highlighted: App.mode === "record" && App.viewedRecordId === model.recordId
                 onClicked: App.selectRecord(model.recordId)
 
                 background: Rectangle {
                     radius: 6
                     color: delegate.highlighted ? "#e3f1e6"
                          : delegate.hovered ? "#f4f7f5" : "transparent"
                 }
 
                 contentItem: Item {
                     Rectangle {
                         id: swatch
                         anchors.left: parent.left
                         anchors.leftMargin: 6
                         anchors.top: parent.top
                         anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                         anchors.topMargin: 8
                         anchors.bottomMargin: 8
                         width: 6
                         radius: 3
                         color: model.color
                     }
 
                     Column {
                         anchors.left: swatch.right
                         anchors.leftMargin: 10
                         anchors.right: parent.right
                         anchors.rightMargin: 6
                         anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                         spacing: 3
 
                         Text {
                             width: parent.width
                             text: (model.date || "") + "   " + (model.tag || "")
                             font.pixelSize: 13
                             font.bold: true
                             color: "#2c3e30"
                             elide: Text.ElideRight
                         }
 
                         Text {
                             width: parent.width
                             text: model.notes && model.notes.length > 0
                                   ? model.notes.replace(/\n/g, " ")
                                   : "No notes"
                             font.pixelSize: 12
                             color: "#6c7c70"
                             elide: Text.ElideRight
                             maximumLineCount: 2
                             wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                         }
                     }
                 }
             }
 
             Text {
                 anchors.centerIn: parent
                 width: parent.width - 30
                 visible: list.count === 0
                 horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                 wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                 text: "Saved treatments will appear here."
                 color: "#94a197"
             }
         }
     }
 }

Index: tools/backup/MapCanvas.qml
===================================================================
--- tools/backup/MapCanvas.qml	
+++ tools/backup/MapCanvas.qml	
@@ -0,0 +1,199 @@
+import QtQuick
+
+Item {
+    id: root
+    objectName: "mapCanvas"
+    clip: true
+
+    property real centerLat: 0
+    property real centerLon: 0
+    property real groundSpanMeters: 70
+    property real zoomFactor: 1
+    property string attribution: "USGS, USDA — The National Map: Orthoimagery"
+    property bool active: true
+
+    readonly property real effectiveGroundSpanMeters: groundSpanMeters / Math.max(zoomFactor, 1e-6)
+    readonly property real effectiveZoom: {
+        const mppAtZoomZero = 156543.03392 * Math.cos(centerLat * Math.PI / 180)
+        return Math.log(Math.max(1e-9, mppAtZoomZero * Math.max(width, 1) / effectiveGroundSpanMeters))
+            / Math.LN2
+    }
+    readonly property int tileZoom: Math.max(1, Math.min(19, Math.floor(effectiveZoom)))
+    readonly property real tileScale: Math.pow(2, effectiveZoom - tileZoom)
+    readonly property real tileDisplaySize: 256 * tileScale
+    readonly property real centerWorldX: lonToWorldX(centerLon, effectiveZoom)
+    readonly property real centerWorldY: latToWorldY(centerLat, effectiveZoom)
+    readonly property real tileCenterWorldX: lonToWorldX(centerLon, tileZoom)
+    readonly property real tileCenterWorldY: latToWorldY(centerLat, tileZoom)
+    readonly property real tileHalfWidthWorld: (width / 2) / Math.max(tileScale, 1e-9)
+    readonly property real tileHalfHeightWorld: (height / 2) / Math.max(tileScale, 1e-9)
+    readonly property int visibleMinTileX: Math.floor((tileCenterWorldX - tileHalfWidthWorld) / 256)
+    readonly property int visibleMaxTileX: Math.floor((tileCenterWorldX + tileHalfWidthWorld) / 256)
+    readonly property int visibleMinTileY: Math.floor((tileCenterWorldY - tileHalfHeightWorld) / 256)
+    readonly property int visibleMaxTileY: Math.floor((tileCenterWorldY + tileHalfHeightWorld) / 256)
+    property var tileItems: []
+    property bool tilesReady: false
+
+    function normalizeLon(lon) {
+        return ((lon + 180) % 360 + 360) % 360 - 180
+    }
+
+    function lonToWorldX(lon, zoom) {
+        return (normalizeLon(lon) + 180) / 360 * 256 * Math.pow(2, zoom)
+    }
+
+    function latToWorldY(lat, zoom) {
+        const clamped = Math.max(-85.05112878, Math.min(85.05112878, lat))
+        const radians = clamped * Math.PI / 180
+        return (1 - Math.log(Math.tan(radians) + 1 / Math.cos(radians)) / Math.PI)
+            / 2 * 256 * Math.pow(2, zoom)
+    }
+
+    function computeTiles() {
+        if (!active || width <= 0 || height <= 0 || !isFinite(effectiveZoom))
+            return []
+
+        const zoom = tileZoom
+        const minX = visibleMinTileX
+        const maxX = visibleMaxTileX
+        const minY = visibleMinTileY
+        const maxY = visibleMaxTileY
+        const tileCount = 1 << zoom
+        const result = []
+
+        for (let tileY = minY; tileY <= maxY; ++tileY) {
+            if (tileY < 0 || tileY >= tileCount)
+                continue
+            for (let tileX = minX; tileX <= maxX; ++tileX) {
+                const sourceX = ((tileX % tileCount) + tileCount) % tileCount
+                result.push({
+                    sourceX: sourceX,
+                    tileX: tileX,
+                    tileY: tileY
+                })
+            }
+        }
+        return result
+    }
+
+    function zoomIn() {
+        zoomFactor = Math.min(8, zoomFactor * 2)
+    }
+
+    function zoomOut() {
+        zoomFactor = Math.max(0.5, zoomFactor / 2)
+    }
+
+    function panBy(dx, dy) {
+        if (!active || width <= 0 || height <= 0)
+            return
+
+        const zoom = effectiveZoom
+        const worldPixels = 256 * Math.pow(2, zoom)
+        const centerX = lonToWorldX(centerLon, zoom) - dx
+        const centerY = latToWorldY(centerLat, zoom) - dy
+        const newLon = normalizeLon(centerX / worldPixels * 360 - 180)
+        const mercatorY = Math.PI - 2 * Math.PI * centerY / worldPixels
+        const newLat = Math.atan(Math.sinh(mercatorY)) * 180 / Math.PI
+
+        centerLat = Math.max(-85, Math.min(85, newLat))
+        centerLon = newLon
+    }
+
+    function evaluateTileReadiness() {
+        let ready = repeater.count > 0
+        for (let i = 0; i < repeater.count; ++i) {
+            const image = repeater.itemAt(i)
+            if (!image || image.status !== Image.Ready) {
+                ready = false
+                break
+            }
+        }
+        if (tilesReady !== ready)
+            tilesReady = ready
+    }
+
+    function rebuildTiles() {
+        console.warn("rebuild", width, height, tileZoom, centerLat, centerLon, visibleMinTileX, visibleMaxTileX, visibleMinTileY, visibleMaxTileY)
+        tileItems = computeTiles()
+    }
+
+    onTileItemsChanged: tilesReady = false
+    onVisibleMinTileXChanged: rebuildTiles()
+    onVisibleMaxTileXChanged: rebuildTiles()
+    onVisibleMinTileYChanged: rebuildTiles()
+    onVisibleMaxTileYChanged: rebuildTiles()
+    onTileZoomChanged: rebuildTiles()
+    onWidthChanged: rebuildTiles()
+    onHeightChanged: rebuildTiles()
+    onActiveChanged: rebuildTiles()
+    Component.onCompleted: rebuildTiles()
+
+    Repeater {
+        id: repeater
+        model: root.tileItems
+        delegate: Image {
+            required property var modelData
+
+            x: modelData.tileX * root.tileDisplaySize - root.centerWorldX + root.width / 2
+            y: modelData.tileY * root.tileDisplaySize - root.centerWorldY + root.height / 2
+            width: root.tileDisplaySize
+            height: root.tileDisplaySize
+            source: root.active
+                ? "image://tiles/" + root.tileZoom + "/" + modelData.sourceX + "/" + modelData.tileY
+                : ""
+            fillMode: Image.Stretch
+            asynchronous: true
+            cache: true
+            smooth: true
+        }
+    }
+
+    MouseArea {
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        enabled: root.active
+        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton
+        cursorShape: Qt.ClosedHandCursor
+
+        property real lastX: 0
+        property real lastY: 0
+
+        onPressed: (mouse) => {
+            lastX = mouse.x
+            lastY = mouse.y
+        }
+        onPositionChanged: (mouse) => {
+            if (!pressed)
+                return
+            root.panBy(mouse.x - lastX, mouse.y - lastY)
+            lastX = mouse.x
+            lastY = mouse.y
+        }
+    }
+
+    Timer {
+        interval: 80
+        repeat: true
+        running: root.active
+        onTriggered: root.evaluateTileReadiness()
+    }
+
+    Rectangle {
+        z: 10
+        anchors.right: parent.right
+        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+        anchors.margins: 4
+        width: attributionText.implicitWidth + 10
+        height: attributionText.implicitHeight + 4
+        radius: 2
+        color: "#e6ffffff"
+
+        Text {
+            id: attributionText
+            anchors.centerIn: parent
+            text: root.attribution
+            font.pixelSize: 10
+            color: "#304437"
+        }
+    }
+}

Index: tools/backup/MapSetupPage.qml
===================================================================
--- tools/backup/MapSetupPage.qml	
+++ tools/backup/MapSetupPage.qml	
@@ -0,0 +1,289 @@
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls
+import QtQuick.Layouts
+import PoisonLog 1.0
+
+Item {
+    id: page
+    objectName: "mapSetupPage"
+
+    property bool hasCenter: false
+    property string chosenAddress: ""
+    property bool saving: false
+
+    function chooseCandidate(candidate) {
+        canvas.centerLat = candidate.lat
+        canvas.centerLon = candidate.lon
+        page.chosenAddress = candidate.displayName
+        page.hasCenter = true
+    }
+
+    function runSearch() {
+        if (addressField.text.trim().length === 0)
+            return
+        App.searchAddress(addressField.text)
+    }
+
+    function saveMap() {
+        if (!page.hasCenter || !canvas.tilesReady || page.saving)
+            return
+
+        page.saving = true
+        App.clearMessages()
+        canvas.grabToImage(function(result) {
+            if (!result) {
+                page.saving = false
+                App.reportError("The map image could not be captured.")
+                return
+            }
+            const path = App.newMapImagePath()
+            if (!result.saveToFile(path)) {
+                page.saving = false
+                App.reportError("The map image could not be saved.")
+                return
+            }
+            App.finishMapSetup(page.chosenAddress, canvas.centerLat, canvas.centerLon,
+                               canvas.effectiveGroundSpanMeters, path, 768, 768)
+            page.saving = false
+        }, Qt.size(768, 768))
+    }
+
+    Connections {
+        target: App
+        function onSearchResultsChanged() {
+            if (App.searchResults.length > 0)
+                page.chooseCandidate(App.searchResults[0])
+        }
+    }
+
+    ColumnLayout {
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        anchors.leftMargin: 28
+        anchors.rightMargin: 28
+        anchors.topMargin: 20
+        anchors.bottomMargin: 20
+        spacing: 10
+
+        Label {
+            text: "Set up the property map"
+            font.pixelSize: 26
+            font.bold: true
+            color: "#1b5e20"
+        }
+
+        Label {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            text: "Search for the property address, then drag the USGS aerial image so the main structure sits under the crosshair. "
+                  + "The default square is about one acre; use +/− to zoom, then save the image."
+            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
+            color: "#4b5f50"
+        }
+
+        RowLayout {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            spacing: 8
+
+            TextField {
+                id: addressField
+                Layout.fillWidth: true
+                placeholderText: "Street address, city, state, postal code"
+                selectByMouse: true
+                onAccepted: page.runSearch()
+            }
+
+            Button {
+                text: App.searching ? "Searching…" : "Search"
+                enabled: !App.searching && addressField.text.trim().length > 0
+                onClicked: page.runSearch()
+            }
+
+            BusyIndicator {
+                running: App.searching
+                visible: App.searching
+                implicitWidth: 32
+                implicitHeight: 32
+            }
+        }
+
+        Frame {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            Layout.preferredHeight: Math.min(138, resultsList.contentHeight + 12)
+            visible: App.searchResults.length > 0
+            padding: 4
+
+            ListView {
+                id: resultsList
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                clip: true
+                model: App.searchResults
+                delegate: ItemDelegate {
+                    width: resultsList.width
+                    text: modelData.displayName
+                    onClicked: page.chooseCandidate(modelData)
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        Item {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            Layout.fillHeight: true
+
+            Item {
+                id: mapHolder
+                anchors.centerIn: parent
+                width: Math.min(parent.width, parent.height)
+                height: width
+                visible: page.hasCenter
+
+                MapCanvas {
+                    id: canvas
+                    anchors.fill: parent
+                    active: page.hasCenter
+                    groundSpanMeters: 70
+                    attribution: "USGS, USDA — The National Map: Orthoimagery"
+                }
+
+                Item {
+                    anchors.fill: parent
+                    z: 50
+
+                    Rectangle {
+                        anchors.centerIn: parent
+                        width: 28
+                        height: 2
+                        color: "#c62828"
+                    }
+                    Rectangle {
+                        anchors.centerIn: parent
+                        width: 2
+                        height: 28
+                        color: "#c62828"
+                    }
+                    Rectangle {
+                        anchors.centerIn: parent
+                        width: 9
+                        height: 9
+                        radius: 5
+                        color: "transparent"
+                        border.color: "#ffffff"
+                        border.width: 2
+                    }
+                }
+
+                Column {
+                    anchors.top: parent.top
+                    anchors.right: parent.right
+                    anchors.margins: 8
+                    spacing: 4
+                    z: 60
+
+                    Button {
+                        text: "+"
+                        font.pixelSize: 20
+                        implicitWidth: 38
+                        implicitHeight: 38
+                        padding: 0
+                        focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
+                        enabled: canvas.zoomFactor < 8
+                        onClicked: canvas.zoomIn()
+                    }
+
+                    Button {
+                        text: "−"
+                        font.pixelSize: 20
+                        implicitWidth: 38
+                        implicitHeight: 38
+                        padding: 0
+                        focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
+                        enabled: canvas.zoomFactor > 0.5
+                        onClicked: canvas.zoomOut()
+                    }
+                }
+
+                Label {
+                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
+                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+                    anchors.bottomMargin: 10
+                    z: 51
+                    visible: !canvas.tilesReady
+                    text: "Loading aerial imagery…"
+                    padding: 6
+                    color: "#ffffff"
+                    background: Rectangle {
+                        color: "#99000000"
+                        radius: 4
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+
+            Rectangle {
+                visible: !page.hasCenter
+                anchors.centerIn: parent
+                width: Math.min(parent.width, 520)
+                height: 110
+                radius: 8
+                color: "#eef2ef"
+                border.color: "#cfd9d1"
+
+                Label {
+                    anchors.centerIn: parent
+                    width: parent.width - 40
+                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
+                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
+                    text: "Search for an address to load the map."
+                    color: "#5b6d5f"
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        RowLayout {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            spacing: 10
+
+            Label {
+                Layout.fillWidth: true
+                text: page.hasCenter ? page.chosenAddress : ""
+                elide: Text.ElideRight
+                maximumLineCount: 1
+                color: "#3f5545"
+            }
+
+            Label {
+                visible: page.hasCenter
+                text: canvas.centerLat.toFixed(5) + ", " + canvas.centerLon.toFixed(5)
+                font.family: "monospace"
+                font.pixelSize: 11
+                color: "#68796c"
+            }
+
+            BusyIndicator {
+                running: page.saving
+                visible: page.saving
+                implicitWidth: 28
+                implicitHeight: 28
+            }
+
+            Button {
+                text: "Save map"
+                enabled: page.hasCenter && canvas.tilesReady && !page.saving
+                onClicked: page.saveMap()
+            }
+        }
+
+        Label {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            visible: App.errorMessage.length > 0
+            text: App.errorMessage
+            color: "#b71c1c"
+            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
+        }
+
+        Label {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            visible: App.errorMessage.length === 0 && App.statusMessage.length > 0
+            text: App.statusMessage
+            color: "#5b6d5f"
+            elide: Text.ElideRight
+        }
+    }
+}

Index: tools/backup/MapView.qml
===================================================================
--- tools/backup/MapView.qml	
+++ tools/backup/MapView.qml	
@@ -0,0 +1,295 @@
+import QtQuick
+import PoisonLog 1.0
+
+Item {
+    id: root
+    objectName: "mapView"
+    clip: true
+
+    function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) {
+        return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, value))
+    }
+
+    function normalizeDelta(value) {
+        return value - 360 * Math.round(value / 360)
+    }
+
+    Rectangle {
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        radius: 8
+        color: "#26342b"
+    }
+
+    Image {
+        id: mapImage
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        source: App.mapImageUrl
+        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
+        asynchronous: true
+        cache: true
+    }
+
+    Text {
+        anchors.centerIn: parent
+        visible: mapImage.status === Image.Error
+        text: "The saved map image could not be loaded."
+        color: "#ffffff"
+    }
+
+    MouseArea {
+        id: createArea
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        enabled: App.mode === "draft" || App.mode === "record-edit"
+        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton
+        z: 0
+
+        property bool drawing: false
+        property real startX: 0
+        property real startY: 0
+
+        function finish(x, y) {
+            const nx = clamp(Math.min(startX, x), 0, 1)
+            const ny = clamp(Math.min(startY, y), 0, 1)
+            const nw = clamp(Math.abs(x - startX), 0, 1 - nx)
+            const nh = clamp(Math.abs(y - startY), 0, 1 - ny)
+            if (nw >= 0.01 && nh >= 0.01)
+                App.addDraftRectangle(nx, ny, nw, nh)
+        }
+
+        onPressed: (mouse) => {
+            App.selectRectangle(-1)
+            startX = clamp(mouse.x / width, 0, 1)
+            startY = clamp(mouse.y / height, 0, 1)
+            rubber.x = startX * width
+            rubber.y = startY * height
+            rubber.width = 0
+            rubber.height = 0
+            rubber.visible = true
+            drawing = true
+        }
+
+        onPositionChanged: (mouse) => {
+            if (!drawing)
+                return
+            const x = clamp(mouse.x / width, 0, 1)
+            const y = clamp(mouse.y / height, 0, 1)
+            rubber.x = Math.min(startX, x) * width
+            rubber.y = Math.min(startY, y) * height
+            rubber.width = Math.abs(x - startX) * width
+            rubber.height = Math.abs(y - startY) * height
+        }
+
+        onReleased: (mouse) => {
+            if (!drawing)
+                return
+            drawing = false
+            rubber.visible = false
+            finish(clamp(mouse.x / width, 0, 1), clamp(mouse.y / height, 0, 1))
+        }
+
+        onCanceled: {
+            drawing = false
+            rubber.visible = false
+        }
+    }
+
+    Repeater {
+        id: rectangleRepeater
+        model: App.rectanglesModel
+
+        delegate: Rectangle {
+            id: rectItem
+            required property int index
+            required property real rx
+            required property real ry
+            required property real rw
+            required property real rh
+            required property real rRotation
+            required property string rColor
+
+            x: rx * root.width
+            y: ry * root.height
+            width: rw * root.width
+            height: rh * root.height
+            z: 1
+            color: "transparent"
+            border.width: App.selectedRectangleIndex === index ? 3 : 2
+            border.color: rColor
+            radius: 1
+            transform: Rotation {
+                origin.x: rectItem.width / 2
+                origin.y: rectItem.height / 2
+                angle: rectItem.rRotation
+            }
+
+            Rectangle {
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                anchors.margins: 1
+                color: rectItem.rColor
+                opacity: 0.22
+            }
+
+            MouseArea {
+                id: moveArea
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                enabled: App.mode === "draft" || App.mode === "record-edit"
+                acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton
+                cursorShape: Qt.SizeAllCursor
+
+                property real pressX: 0
+                property real pressY: 0
+                property real origX: 0
+                property real origY: 0
+
+                onPressed: (mouse) => {
+                    App.selectRectangle(index)
+                    const point = mapToItem(root, mouse.x, mouse.y)
+                    pressX = point.x
+                    pressY = point.y
+                    origX = rectItem.rx
+                    origY = rectItem.ry
+                }
+
+                onPositionChanged: (mouse) => {
+                    if (!pressed)
+                        return
+                    const point = mapToItem(root, mouse.x, mouse.y)
+                    const nx = root.clamp(origX + (point.x - pressX) / root.width,
+                                          0, 1 - rectItem.rw)
+                    const ny = root.clamp(origY + (point.y - pressY) / root.height,
+                                          0, 1 - rectItem.rh)
+                    App.updateDraftRectangle(index, nx, ny, rectItem.rw, rectItem.rh, false)
+                }
+
+                onReleased: App.saveDraftRectangles()
+            }
+
+            Rectangle {
+                width: 14
+                height: 14
+                radius: 3
+                anchors.right: parent.right
+                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+                visible: App.mode === "draft" || App.mode === "record-edit"
+                color: rectItem.rColor
+                border.color: "#ffffff"
+                border.width: 2
+
+                MouseArea {
+                    anchors.fill: parent
+                    anchors.margins: -5
+                    enabled: App.mode === "draft" || App.mode === "record-edit"
+                    cursorShape: Qt.SizeFDiagCursor
+
+                    property real pressX: 0
+                    property real pressY: 0
+                    property real origW: 0
+                    property real origH: 0
+
+                    onPressed: (mouse) => {

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a copyright block from cr.txt to the top of files that don't already have it."""

import sys
import os
import shutil
import re

COMMENT_STYLES = {
    'hash': '# ',
    'slash': '// ',
    'html': '<!-- ',
    'lua': '-- ',
    'haskell': '-- ',
    'fortran': '! ',
    'tex': '% ',
    'asm': '; ',
    'plain': '',
}

EXTENSION_MAP = {
    # hash
    '.py': 'hash', '.pyw': 'hash', '.pyx': 'hash',
    '.rb': 'hash', '.rbw': 'hash',
    '.sh': 'hash', '.bash': 'hash', '.zsh': 'hash', '.ksh': 'hash',
    '.yaml': 'hash', '.yml': 'hash',
    '.cmake': 'hash', '.makefile': 'hash', '.mk': 'hash',
    '.txt': 'plain',
    '.env': 'hash', '.ini': 'hash', '.cfg': 'hash', '.conf': 'hash',
    '.dockerfile': 'hash',
    '.procfile': 'hash',
    '.gemfile': 'hash', '.gemspec': 'hash',
    '.rakefile': 'hash',
    '.editorconfig': 'hash',
    '.gitignore': 'hash', '.dockerignore': 'hash', '.gitattributes': 'hash',
    # slash
    '.js': 'slash', '.jsx': 'slash', '.mjs': 'slash', '.cjs': 'slash',
    '.ts': 'slash', '.tsx': 'slash', '.mts': 'slash', '.cts': 'slash',
    '.css': 'slash', '.scss': 'slash', '.less': 'slash',
    '.java': 'slash',
    '.c': 'slash', '.cpp': 'slash', '.h': 'slash', '.hpp': 'slash',
    '.cs': 'slash',
    '.swift': 'slash',
    '.go': 'slash',
    '.rs': 'slash',
    '.qml': 'slash',
    '.kt': 'slash', '.kts': 'slash',
    '.dart': 'slash',
    '.groovy': 'slash', '.gvy': 'slash',
    '.scala': 'slash',
    '.sass': 'slash',
    '.pcss': 'slash',
    # html
    '.html': 'html', '.htm': 'html',
    '.xml': 'html', '.svg': 'html', '.xhtml': 'html', '.xslt': 'html',
    '.xsd': 'html', '.xsl': 'html',
    '.csproj': 'html', '.vcxproj': 'html', '.fsproj': 'html',
    # lua
    '.lua': 'lua',
    # haskell
    '.hs': 'haskell',
    # fortran
    '.f': 'fortran', '.f90': 'fortran', '.f95': 'fortran', '.f03': 'fortran',
    # tex
    '.tex': 'tex', '.sty': 'tex', '.cls': 'tex', '.bib': 'tex',
    # asm
    '.asm': 'asm', '.s': 'asm', '.S': 'asm',
}

SHEBANG_LIKE = re.compile(r'^(#!|-\*-|// ==)')

def detect_style(filepath):
    ext = os.path.splitext(filepath)[1].lower()
    basename = os.path.basename(filepath).lower()
    if basename in ('makefile', 'rakefile', 'gemfile', 'procfile'):
        return 'hash'
    if basename == 'dockerfile':
        return 'hash'
    return EXTENSION_MAP.get(ext, 'plain')

def read_copyright(path='cr.txt'):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print(f"error: {path} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    with open(path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        return f.read()

def copyright_block(text, style):
    prefix = COMMENT_STYLES[style]
    lines = text.strip().splitlines()
    commented = []
    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            commented.append(prefix.rstrip())
        else:
            commented.append(f"{prefix}{stripped}")
    return '\n'.join(commented) + '\n'

def already_has_copyright(content, text):
    lines = content.splitlines()
    if not lines:
        return False
    first_line = lines[0].strip()
    if not first_line:
        return False
    cr_first = text.strip().splitlines()[0].strip()
    if not cr_first:
        return False
    return cr_first in first_line or first_line in cr_first

def process_file(filepath, cr_text, style, backup_dir):
    with open(filepath, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()

    if already_has_copyright(content, cr_text):
        print(f"skip  {filepath}")
        return

    os.makedirs(backup_dir, exist_ok=True)
    backup_path = os.path.join(backup_dir, os.path.basename(filepath))
    shutil.copy2(filepath, backup_path)

    lines = content.splitlines(keepends=True)
    insert_idx = 0
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if SHEBANG_LIKE.match(line.strip()) or line.strip() == '':
            insert_idx = i + 1
        else:
            break

    block = copyright_block(cr_text, style)
    prefix = ''.join(lines[:insert_idx])
    rest = ''.join(lines[insert_idx:])
    new_content = prefix + block + '\n' + rest

    with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(new_content)
    print(f"patch {filepath}")

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print(f"usage: {sys.argv[0]} <file> [file ...]", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    cr_text = read_copyright()
    backup_dir = 'backup'

    for filepath in sys.argv[1:]:
        if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
            print(f"skip  {filepath} (not a file)")
            continue
        style = detect_style(filepath)
        process_file(filepath, cr_text, style, backup_dir)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
